Predict ages at new positions from a modBchron (or modifiedBChron) model

Source: R/modBchron.R
modBchron_predict.Rd

This function is used to predict the age of new stratigraphic points using the output from an ageModel run.

Usage

modBchron_predict(
  model,
  newPositions,
  ids = 1:length(newPositions),
  newPositionThicknesses = rep(0, length(newPositions)),
  probability = 0.95
)

Arguments

model

Age-depth model, the output of modBchron (a list with at least model, predictPositions and burn). Required (no default).

newPositions

Stratigraphic positions whose age is predicted, in the unit of the positions of the model (numeric vector); they must lie within the predictPositions range of the original model run, outside it the prediction is NA. Required (no default).

ids

Names of the new positions, used as row names of the output (character or numeric vector, same length as newPositions). Default=1:length(newPositions).

newPositionThicknesses

Stratigraphic uncertainty of each new position, given as half thickness in the unit of newPositions (numeric vector, >= 0, same length and order as newPositions); in every MCMC iteration the position is drawn uniformly within plus or minus this value. Default=rep(0, length(newPositions)) (no positional uncertainty).

probability

Probability of the returned highest density interval (numeric, between 0 and 1). Default=0.95.

Value

HDI = 95 percent Highest Density Interval for each newPosition

raw = Age predictions for each newPosition for each MCMC run.
